What to bring

Skip a return trip. Have these ready before you head out.

Required documents
Current driver's license (even if expired)
Proof of residency dated within 90 days
Social Security card, last 4 digits OK
Payment for the $30 renewal fee — card or check, no cash above $20
Helpful, not required
Eyeglasses or contacts if you wear them (we test vision on site)
Updated address or emergency contact
Organ donor preference (yes, no, or "ask me later")
A book. Honestly. Even on time, we run a little behind.

Reschedule, 24+ hours ahead	Free, no questions asked	→

No-show	Slot released, rebooking allowed after 48 hours	→
Missing documents at arrival	Check-in deferred; you may join the walk-in queue same day	→
Office closure (weather, civic)	We move your slot to the next equivalent window	→
Accessibility & accommodations

All DMV offices are step-free, with assistive listening at every staffed counter and large-print forms available on request. Service animals welcome.
